index.metaDescription: Free, open-source animated components for React Native and Expo, built for touch with Reanimated, Gesture Handler and Uniwind. Copy the source or install with npx beui-native.
index.heading: Animated React Native components
index.intro: Built for touch with Reanimated, Gesture Handler and Uniwind. Copy the source into your Expo or React Native app.
index.setup: New here? <link>Set up your app</link> once, then add any component with the CLI.

component.metaDescription: {description} An animated, accessible React Native component for Expo and bare apps, built with Reanimated.
component.webDescription: The React version of {name}, built with Motion and Tailwind CSS.

panel.worksIn: It works in Expo and in bare React Native. New to beUI Native? <link>Set up your app first</link>.
panel.cli: Copies the component and the shared files it needs into src/, adds the theme tokens if they're missing, and installs its libraries. Files you've changed are kept.
panel.manualIntro: Keep the folder layout, since the component imports the shared files by relative path.
panel.gestureRoot: Wrap your app in GestureHandlerRootView if it isn't already.
panel.themeBody: Once per app. Import it from the CSS file Uniwind reads, after Tailwind and Uniwind, and change the values to match your brand.

changelog.heading: What's new in beUI
